'''Trumpets''' were a type of [[Music/Legends|wind musical instrument]]. The [[Anointed People]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abonshee]] used trumpets to herald the arrival of the [[Godking]] into the presence of his subjects.<ref name="Godking" /> The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of the [[Forest/Legends|Forest]] [[Moon/Legends|Moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] also used [[Horn/Legends|horns]], including trumpets, in their celebrations.<ref name="ROTJ" />
